### Fixed
- **The managers are pinned to the kagent API version the 4.x line serves** (giantswarm/agent-platform#401): `model-manager.kagent.apiVersion` and `agent-manager.kagent.apiVersion` are `v1alpha3` in the meta chart's values — the managers' charts default to `auto`, which discovers the served `kagent.dev` version once at start-up and bakes it into the client. On an in-place 3.x → 4.x upgrade nothing in model-manager's values or pod template changed, so its pod never rolled: it kept the `v1alpha2` it had discovered under kagent 0.10 while `kagent-crds` had replaced the CRDs with `v1alpha3` only, and every ModelConfig call failed with `list ModelConfigs in kagent: the server could not find the requested resource` — a pulled model could not be wired until the pod happened to restart (found by the migration rehearsal, giantswarm/agentlab#143, `models-test` on a lab upgraded in place from 3.23.1 to 4.7.14; agent-manager's pod rolled only because its chart moved to 1.1.x). Both charts render the key as the container's `--kagent-api-version=v1alpha3`, so the pin is the values change that rolls both Deployments on the cut-over, after `kagent-crds` is Ready (both `dependsOn` it), and every manager speaks `v1alpha3` from its first request. `make verify-components` asserts the pin in both forwarded release values; `verify-components-charts` renders both manager charts with the forwarded values and asserts the argument reaches the pod template. UPGRADE.md "3.x → 4.0 (the kagent line)" carries the operator's side: the managers roll once, nothing to do. **No installation acts** — the release stays inert behind the fleet's `<4.0.0` bound; an installation already on 4.x sees both managers roll once on the next reconcile.
